messages:
Arjun: Rolling config-only update 'rate-sculptor' to adjust per-route burst to 40, soft timeout 1.8s, routing policy weighted fallback -> regional-lowcost. Need change window + rollback plan. Thinking 15:30 PT today. @Maya @Simon pls weigh in.

DeployBot: deploy-bot: starting dry-run for config: rate-sculptor (rs-20260320-1). Dry-run OK — schema validated; applied to staging nodes (s-2a, s-2b). Logs: https://internal.corp/deploy/rs-20260320-1

Maya: post-peak window sounds good. Recommend canary 2% for 10m, then 10% for 10m, then 100% if no regressions. Add manual hold at 10%.

Simon: +1. Also suggest QPS cap per-tenant -> 120 rps, burst -> 40. And bump kvcache ttl to 3s to reduce cache churn under short seqs.

Ellie: I'll watch tail latency. Set SLO alert: p95 > baseline*1.2 OR p99 > baseline*1.25 -> trigger rollback.

Samir: Auto-rollback criteria? Propose: >5% error rate OR p99 latency > 2.5s sustained for 5m -> auto-rollback. How will route fallbacks affect model pins? This is config-only but could route to older variants.

Arjun: No model pin changes. Routing policy prefers same model version; fallback route will only use model-v1.9 in extreme cases. We'll annotate in release notes.

DeployBot: canary started @ 15:31 PT at 2% traffic. Monitoring dashboards: https://internal.corp/monitor/rs-20260320-1

Maya: If canary ok at 15:41, ramp to 20% then hold for 10m. Ellie to signoff for full 100% at ~15:55.

OpsBot: Reminder: change window 15:30-16:30 PT. Pager rotation during change: Samir -> Ellie -> Simon.

Ellie: Seeing a small p95 uptick (+12%) at 15:34, no errors. Monitoring.

Simon: k6 stress tests show some queueing at 200 rps but within expected headroom. Fine for 20% ramp.

Arjun: Starting ramp to 20% now. Config id rs-20260320-1. Release notes draft:
- per-route QPS cap: 120
- burst: 40
- soft timeout: 1.8s
- kvcache ttl: 3s
- routing policy: weighted fallback -> regional-lowcost
Rollback command: /deploy rollback-config rs-20260320-1

DeployBot: ramp to 20% complete. No alert triggers.

Ellie: Marking canary successful so far. I'll post perf snapshots to #eng-observability and follow up in general.

Arjun: Thanks all — will wait 15m then do final ramp if nothing else. Anything else?

Maya: All good from my side. :thumbsup:
